dataset.description: Configurable parameters to construct the dataset for a DINOv3 experiment.

pin_memory.description: Flag to enable the dataloader to allocated pagelocked memory for faster of data between the CPU and GPU.
pin_memory.title: pin_memory

test_dataset.description: Configuration for the testing dataset path

images_dir.description: Path to the extracted images directory for the dataset (not an archive such as .tar.gz)
images_dir.title: image directory

test_dataset.title: Testing Dataset

train_dataset.description: Configuration for the training dataset path

images_dir.description: Path to the extracted images directory for the dataset (not an archive such as .tar.gz)
images_dir.title: image directory

train_dataset.title: Training Dataset

global_crops_size.description: Size of global crops for DINOv3 training.
global_crops_size.title: Global Crops Size

local_crops_size.description: Size of local crops (multiple of patch 16)
local_crops_size.title: Local Crops Size

n_global_crops.description: Number of global crops to generate
n_global_crops.title: Number of Global Crops

n_local_crops.description: Number of local crops to generate
n_local_crops.title: Number of Local Crops

workers.description: The number of parallel workers processing data
workers.title: batch size

export.description: Configurable parameters to export for a DINOv3 experiment.

checkpoint.description: Path to a stripped DINOv3 teacher checkpoint or a full Lightning training checkpoint. Export always selects the EMA teacher backbone.
checkpoint.title: Path to checkpoint file

opset_version.description: Operator set version of the ONNX model used to generate the TensorRT engine.
opset_version.title: opset version

model.description: Configurable parameters to construct the model for a DINOv3 experiment.

drop_path_rate.description: Drop path rate for stochastic depth regularization
drop_path_rate.title: drop path rate

img_size.description: Backbone image size. Supported values are 256, 512, and 768.
img_size.title: image size

num_register_tokens.description: Number of register tokens (DINOv3 ViT-B uses 4)
num_register_tokens.title: num register tokens

rope_theta.description: Frequency base for 2D axial RoPE. Must match the timm DINOv3 reference; verified by the step-4 feature-parity smoke test.
rope_theta.title: RoPE theta

student_type.description: Student backbone name. TAO's DINOv3 supports vit_s, vit_s_plus, vit_b, vit_l, vit_h_plus and vit_7b.
student_type.title: student backbone

teacher_type.description: Teacher backbone name. TAO's DINOv3 supports vit_s, vit_s_plus, vit_b, vit_l, vit_h_plus and vit_7b.
teacher_type.title: teacher backbone

centering_method.description: Teacher-output centering for the DINO/iBOT heads. DINOv3 uses Sinkhorn-Knopp (SwAV); 'softmax' is the DINOv2 fallback. If training shows instability/collapse, try 'softmax'.
centering_method.title: centering method

disable_masking.description: Whether to disable masking when distillation
disable_masking.title: disable_masking

pretrained_non_distill_pl_model_path.description: Path to a pre-trained pl model from non-distillation DINOv2 SSL pipe for initializing teacher in distillation.

enable.description: Whether to add the Gram-anchoring loss term
enable.title: enable gram

refresh_interval.description: Steps between refreshing the Gram teacher from the EMA teacher (only when teacher_source='ema'). 0 = never refresh (frozen snapshot, Phase 0 behavior).
refresh_interval.title: gram refresh interval

start_step.description: Global step at which the Gram term activates
start_step.title: gram start step

teacher_scale.description: Resolution multiple at which the Gram teacher runs relative to the student. DINOv3 computes Gram on higher-res teacher features; the teacher grid is average-pooled back to the student grid before the loss. 1.0 = same resolution (default, memory-safe). The paper uses 2.0, but at 768 the teacher then runs at 1536 (96x96=9216 tokens) -> heavy; raise to 1.5/2.0 only if memory allows.
teacher_scale.title: gram teacher scale

teacher_source.description: Source of the frozen Gram teacher weights: 'pretrained' anchors to the loaded DINOv3 weights (Phase 0 default); 'ema' uses an early-EMA snapshot of the current run's teacher, refreshed every 'refresh_interval' steps (Phase 1 / high-res).
teacher_source.title: gram teacher source

w_gram.description: Weight of the Gram-anchoring loss term
w_gram.title: gram weight

head.description: Configuration for the DINOv3 head (reused from nvdinov2)

bottleneck_dim.description: Dimension of the bottleneck layer in the NVDINOv2 head
bottleneck_dim.title: bottleneck dimension

hidden_dim.description: Dimension of the hidden layers in the NVDINOv2 head
hidden_dim.title: hidden dimension

num_layers.description: Number of layers in the NVDINOv2 head
num_layers.title: number of Layers

lora.description: Configuration for LoRA parameter-efficient continual pre-training

alpha.description: LoRA scaling alpha; the applied scale is alpha / rank.
alpha.title: lora alpha

dropout.description: Dropout applied to the LoRA branch input only (the frozen base path is untouched).
dropout.title: lora dropout

enable.description: Whether to apply LoRA adapters to the backbone (parameter-efficient SSL)
enable.title: enable lora

num_last_blocks.description: Adapt only the last N transformer blocks. 0 = all blocks.
num_last_blocks.title: lora num last blocks

rank.description: LoRA rank (r). The low-rank update is dW = (alpha/r) * B @ A.
rank.title: lora rank

target_modules.description: Projections to adapt inside each targeted ViT block. 'qkv' and 'proj' are the attention projections (the v1 default); 'fc1'/'fc2' additionally adapt the FFN. SwiGLU backbones (ViT-S+/H+/7B) expose a fused fc1 and are deferred in v1.
target_modules.title: lora target modules

preservation.description: Configuration for CLS-token preservation against the frozen anchor teacher

cls_cosine_weight.description: Weight of the CLS-token cosine preservation term (0 disables just this term).
cls_cosine_weight.title: cls cosine weight

cls_mse_weight.description: Weight of the CLS-token MSE preservation term (0 disables just this term).
cls_mse_weight.title: cls mse weight

enable.description: Whether to add CLS-token preservation losses against the frozen anchor teacher. Recommended alongside LoRA for continual pre-training.
enable.title: enable preservation

model_name.description: Name of model if invoking task via :code:`model_agnostic`
model_name.title: Model name

results_dir.description: Path to where all the assets generated from a task are stored.
results_dir.title: Results directory

train.description: Configurable parameters to construct the trainer for a DINOv3 experiment.

checkpoint_interval.description: The interval (in epochs) at which a checkpoint will be saved. Helps resume training.
checkpoint_interval.title: Checkpoint interval

checkpoint_interval_unit.description: The unit of the checkpoint interval.
checkpoint_interval_unit.title: Checkpoint interval unit

dirpath.description: Directory for best checkpoints. Defaults to results_dir.

enable_topk.description: Save checkpoint(s) ranked by a monitored metric. This is additive to periodic checkpoints unless replace_periodic is enabled.
enable_topk.title: Enable best-checkpoint saving

mode.description: Leave unset to use the network's default direction.
mode.title: Monitor mode

monitor.description: Leave unset to use the network's default metric.
monitor.title: Monitored metric

replace_periodic.description: When best-checkpoint saving is enabled, replace periodic history with one metric-best checkpoint and its latest symlink.
replace_periodic.title: Replace periodic checkpoints

cudnn.description: CuDNN settings compatible with DINOv3 custom attention.

benchmark.description: Enable CuDNN benchmarking for DINOv3 training.
benchmark.title: CuDNN benchmark

deterministic.description: Enable deterministic CuDNN behavior. Keep disabled when using DINOv3 custom attention, which has no deterministic backward implementation.
deterministic.title: CuDNN deterministic

distributed_strategy.description: Lightning distributed strategy. 'auto' keeps the nvdinov2 behaviour (single-device or DDP). 'fsdp' shards params/grads/optimizer (FULL_SHARD) for high-resolution and large-backbone multi-GPU training.
distributed_strategy.title: distributed strategy

gpu_ids.description:
List of GPU IDs to run the training on. The length of this list
        must be equal to the number of gpus in train.num_gpus.
gpu_ids.title: GPU IDs

log_every_n_steps.description: Number of training steps between logger updates.
log_every_n_steps.title: logging interval

num_epochs.description: Number of epochs to run the training.
num_epochs.title: Number of epochs

num_gpus.description: The number of GPUs to run the train job.
num_gpus.title: Number of GPUs

num_nodes.description: Number of nodes to run the training on. If > 1, then multi-node is enabled.
num_nodes.title: Number of nodes

pretrained_model_path.description: Path to DINOv3 pretrained weights matching the configured backbone. Accepts a timm-format directory or file, or a stripped TAO DINOv3 backbone checkpoint. DINOv2/NVDINOv2 checkpoints are not supported.

results_dir.description: Path to where all the assets generated from a task are stored.
results_dir.title: Results directory

resume_training_checkpoint_path.description: Path to the checkpoint to resume training from.
resume_training_checkpoint_path.title: Resume checkpoint path

last_layer_learning_rate.description: Last layer learning rate scheduler configuration

val_base.description: The value after warm-up for scheduler.
val_base.title: base value

val_base.description: The value after warm-up for scheduler
val_base.title: base value

val_base.description: The value after warm-up for scheduler
val_base.title: base value

val_base.description: The value after warm-up for scheduler
val_base.title: base value

val_base.description: The value after warm-up for scheduler
val_base.title: base value

seed.description: The seed for the initializer in PyTorch. If < 0, disable fixed seed.
seed.title: Seed for randomization

validation_interval.description:
The interval (in epochs) at which a evaluation
        will be triggered on the validation dataset.
validation_interval.title: Validation interval
